notes.title: Stellar Cardworks Demo Update Devlog v0.2.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here’s what’s new in the latest demo update:

[olist]
[*] Task System Overhaul

[list]
[*] Task cards have been removed — tasks are now managed through a dedicated UI.
[*] Added a variety of new task types and rebalanced difficulty.
[/list]
[*] New Combat System

[list]
[*] The Cosmic Threat Level now reflects the intensity of Ravager invasions.
[/list]
[*] Planet Selection Revamp

[list]
[*] Expedition team configuration has been added.
[*] Added the ability to customize starting supplies.

[/list]
[*] Crafting & Production Tweaks

[list]
[*] Some food items have been removed.
[*] Added new buildings that affect resident satisfaction.
[*] Rebalanced overall resource output.
[/list]
[*] Spaceship Shop Update

[list]
[*] Adjusted item offerings in the ship’s store.
[/list]
[/olist]

Thank you for playing! If you have any feedback, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/zXZW5t7M6w][u][b]Discord[/b][/u][/url] and share your thoughts with us.

We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the game!
